card.name: Digits inside trial counts and percentages
card.fires_on: A digit (or decimal point) in the middle of a number in clinical-trial results, such as the denominator of a patient count or the leading digit of a percentage. It fires most when more digits are still to come.

modes.label: Denominator in a count
modes.description: First or middle digit of the total in an n/N patient count inside parentheses.

modes.label: Leading digit of a percentage
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit percentage in adverse-reaction or response rates.
